episode_in_one_sentence: As agents gain more reach, the enterprise test is whether access, cost, context and evidence remain legible after the demo.

listener_notes.note: An abstract infrastructure thesis delayed the first concrete event.
Memory as governed state was useful, but the same control advice returned in later desks.
Unnamed clusters and a post-handback addendum felt like a memo read aloud.
Incident and quota threads were discussed without distinguishing verified Hacker News from unverified Reddit leads.
The manifest-versus-policy contrast worked, though it needed an actual release change.
Repeated observability advice obscured the sharper Cloudflare traffic distinction.
Whole-run evidence mattered; paper names and publication timing were missing.
The checklist restated prior advice rather than giving distinct watch items.

after_evidence.hook: Cloudflare bot-access distinction opens in 97 words, about 38 seconds, with two clear questions.
after_evidence.audience_fit: Product-specification access, engineering handoffs, scheduled job economics, customer channels and maintenance-record oversight have different enterprise uses.
after_evidence.specificity: Names Cloudflare, Grdinic, Tencent DataBuddy, Microsoft Agent Framework, GitHub's connector release, Agents API, READY and AgentAudit.
after_evidence.non_redundancy: Social owns access, YouTube continuity, X verification, Reddit pricing and practitioner limits, Builders implementation, Launches buying stages, Research qualification.
after_evidence.clarity_for_ear: Average sentence is 12.5 words; no sentence exceeds 30 words; transitions introduce the next distinct story.
after_evidence.momentum: The Cloudflare gate arrives first; Grdinic's walking-character example, the suspect mega-agent claim and actual release notes reset attention.
after_evidence.voice_distinctness: Marcus sells the videos, Priya punctures a viral claim, Sam contrasts forum chatter with the rate card, Maya reads release notes, Aaron reasons from papers.
after_evidence.flow_and_handoffs: All seven correspondents hand back at the end; short pivots, the X fact-check cue and the builder-to-buyer callback vary the transitions.
after_evidence.accuracy: The supposed ten-thousand-agent feat is explicitly a post's claim; Cloudflare details are attributed to posts; earlier September publications are not called new this week.
after_evidence.tts_readiness: No symbol warnings or overlong sentences; API and AI are letter acronyms, READY is pronounced as a word, and dot net is written phonetically.
after_evidence.close: Three specific watch items concern publisher access rules, connector compatibility and evidence of oversight cost; no repeated pilot checklist.

warnings_left_by_design.reason: Remaining terms are episode dates and generic connective vocabulary such as 'whether', 'question' and 'different', plus the shared enterprise subject; the concrete advice and substantive story owner differ by desk.

summary_for_producer: The draft had an abstract opening, unnamed clusters, repeated guardrail advice and four premature handbacks. The edit opens on a concrete, attributed Cloudflare access story, gives each desk distinct material, and separates verified primary statements from posts and unverified community leads. Microsoft and GitHub release changes, the Agents API beta, Sponsored Agents test, evaluation partnership, READY and AgentAudit now have named roles. The finished 20.9-minute script has zero lint errors; the one remaining conceptual-vocabulary warning is benign. Watch the source feed's inconsistent dating and unverifiable social and Reddit links next week.
